event_field_guide.event_id: Unique discovery-event identifier; not a mutant or routine substrate identifier
event_field_guide.paper_id: DOI or stable primary publication identifier for dependence grouping
event_field_guide.inclusion_reason: Why this is an eligible independent catalytic transformation
event_field_guide.event_earliest_public_date: Verified YYYY-MM-DD or null until resolved
event_field_guide.event_date_evidence: Public version history and exact evidence; not received/accepted date
event_field_guide.event_experiment_locator: Original scheme/table/SI page and compound identifiers
event_field_guide.strata: Separate arrays for transformation, activation and platform; allow unknown and overlap
event_field_guide.precedents: Objects containing source, experiment locator, date evidence, nonenzymatic catalyst evidence, structures, corpus record IDs, match rationale and per-encoder ranks
event_field_guide.search_log: Timestamped queries, engine/corpus version, inspected candidates, actual minutes and incomplete steps
event_field_guide.review: Reviewer identities, review dates, disagreements and adjudication
